v1_human_g3_constraints.c_1: The list should only contain string characters
v1_human_g3_constraints.c_3: Each time is represented by hour:minute
v1_human_g3_constraints.c_5: Meeting duration should be an integer
v1_human_g3_constraints.c_6: First parameter should be a list

v1_human_g3_frs.fr_1: The user shall be able to enter a desired meeting duration
v1_human_g3_frs.fr_2: The user shall be able enter an existing list full of events
v1_human_g3_frs.fr_3: The system shall return a list of available times
v1_human_g3_frs.fr_4: The system shall return an empty list if no available time is found

v1_human_g3_goal: The objective of the system is to give the user a list of valid start-times where they can schedule a meeting.
v1_human_g3_input: Existing calender events- list, where each time is in string format, valid times are 0-24 desired meeting duration - double, it is formatted in hours

v1_human_g3_invariants.inv_2: NO 2 events can be held at the same time
v1_human_g3_invariants.inv_3: No meeting time 11:00 and beyond should be on the return list

v1_human_g3_neg_req.neg_req_1: A list that contains hour outside of valid working hours
v1_human_g3_neg_req.neg_req_2: An empty list even though there's an available time

v1_human_g3_output: The function will return a list of times which are in a string format.
v1_human_g3_tie_breaking: The system should choose the earliest time if two scenarios satisfy the same constraint
